in_sanskrit.name: Barsha

in_marathi.name: Barsha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Barsha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Barsha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vrshabha’, which means rain, monsoon, or a cloudburst. This name is often used to describe the arrival of the monsoon season or the onset of rains.
